subject: raccoon
scope: Still keys only; no motion approval. First six board tiles compared with design.png and selected source contact sheets.

identity.verdict: The angular smiling head, two small eye marks, broad unfilled body, sparse stick legs and striped wedge tail remain recognizably the same chosen doodle across all six keys.

source_pose.verdict: The source changes from a compact, nearly frontal crouch to a left-facing, rounded side crouch. The keys mostly keep the same long broadside body and standing legs while lowering or narrowing the face; the whole-animal turn is not readable.

one_gap_that_matters_most: The torso and leg silhouette do not carry the source frontal-to-side crouching turn.
smallest_repair: Retain the current stroke vocabulary and facial marks, but foreshorten the torso and overlap the stick legs in keys 1-2, then open the torso toward the left-facing side crouch through keys 3-6. Let the shoulder and rump silhouette carry the change instead of changing only the head.
must_not_be_lost: Angular smiling face and original small eye marks
Large simple unfilled body, four sparse leg strokes and striped wedge tail
Uneven original doodle line character; do not add realistic raccoon features
